verdict.rationale: Linear documents several first-party natural-language surfaces. Loops let you describe recurring jobs in plain language. Users can @mention Linear Agent in comments ("@Linear can you take a stab at this?"), edit text and draft updates with the agent, and develop projects through the agent-driven project composer. An official MCP server also lets Claude and Cursor operate Linear conversationally. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these agent features, and explicit evidence that natural-language commands cover core in-app operations such as creating, filtering or updating issues broadly rather than specific agent workflows.
